page.overview:
Who is Stone?

Ensign Stone was a Starfleet officer whose first assignment out of Starfleet Academy was aboard the , under Captain Blackwood.

Stone noted in their personal log that their first week of active duty was a nightmare, even after four years at the Academy, as the captain seemed to enjoy persecuting new recruits. Stone had been told by the first officer not to take it personally, but Stone was nonetheless having difficulty doing so due to the circumstances involved.

Stone, along with the rest of the crew of the Tombaugh, were assimilated by the Borg in 2362, a fact that was unknown at the time by Starfleet Command.

In 2375, when the encountered a Borg neural interlink frequency, Seven of Nine began to experience the personalities of various assimilated individuals, including Stone. ()
